pp1.7:2.2: sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggova hoti, ummujjitvā nimujjati, ummujjitvā ṭhito hoti, ummujjitvā vipassati viloketi, ummujjitvā patarati, ummujjitvā paṭigādhappatto hoti, ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
pp1.7:3.1: ubhatobhāgavimutto, paññāvimutto, kāyasakkhī, diṭṭhappatto, saddhāvimutto, dhammānusārī, saddhānusārī.
